integrity.originality_risk: Possible unindexed equivalent specialization of graph toric or binomial-hypersurface literature; a relevant 2011 paper had no full text obtained.
integrity.proof_basis: Primitive integer incidence relation, monomial partial-derivative support classification, analytic unit absorption, and Serre normality criterion.
integrity.reproducibility: Standalone standard-library checker and its exact bounded output; tests are not an infinite proof.

limitations: The singular locus is classified as a reduced variety and generic complex analytic transverse germs only. No claim about full Jacobian scheme, nongeneric intersections, global normalization map, or positive characteristic. The normality criterion itself is established prior art.
title: Singular-component census of two-odd-cycle edge hypersurfaces
